title: Photo is deceptive. Really great throw but is PRETTY thin.
text: Photo is deceptive. Really great throw but is PRETTY thin.. This is really very thin but it's fairly good quality and looks really nice. I love it for days/ nights when I am just slightly chilly. Then I can throw that on and knock the chill off. If it's a colder night I can grab a thicker throw. it's nice having options so this one definitely does serve a purpose still!
